title: 2027 Human Lander Challenge
about: NASA's 2027 Human Lander Challenge asks U.S.-based collegiate teams and faculty advisers to propose systems-level lunar communications solutions. Proposal packages (five-to-seven-page proposal and two-minute video) are due 4 March 2027; finalists present in Huntsville, Alabama.
requirements: United States-based collegiate team with a faculty adviser
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for 2027 Human Lander Challenge at NASA, United States, deadline 4 Mar 2027. The background photo shows the Statue of Liberty in front of the Manhattan skyline and the Empire State Building in New York.
